title: An extension to ℝ^P with support in a compact K ⊂ U has no more mass or boundary mass than its restriction to U
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open and K ⊆ U compact. Let X ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) (SimonGMT GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) and Y ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ (m + 1)) be currents such that (a) Y restricts to X, i.e. Y.restrictDomain (subset_univ U) = X: Y(ιη) = X(η) for every η ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}(U), where ι = testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) regards a test form in U (TestFormOn U (m + 1): a smooth form on ℝ^P with compact support contained in U) as a test form on ℝ^P without changing it; and (b) spt Y ⊆ K, where spt is the support of Simon 6.2.11 (GeometricCurrentOn.support). Then M(Y) ≤ M(X) and M(∂Y) ≤ M(∂X). Here ∂ is GeometricCurrentOn.boundary (∂Z(ω) = Z(dω)); M(Y) = Y.mass = Y.massOn ℝ^P and M(X) = X.mass = X.massOn U, where Z.massOn W is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal(Z(ω)) over test forms ω in the domain of Z with tsupport ω ⊆ W and covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for all x (Simon 6.2.4–6.2.5).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → Y.restrictDomain (subset_univ U) = X → Y.support ⊆ K → Y.mass ≤ X.mass ∧ Y.boundary.mass ≤ X.boundary.mass
